original.statement: Karpenter v1.0.0 fixes a failure launching Windows pods when the instance type is not in the vpc resource controller config.

decision.reason: [ev-664e993932dd] describes a bug fix: Windows pods no longer fail to launch when the instance type isn't in the vpc resource controller config. That is a change in how Karpenter works with another component's configuration, and nothing about the configuration itself changes. So product-relationship "vpc-resource-controller" with behavior-changed fits better than protocol-behavior, because no wire or protocol behaviour is involved. The evidence doesn't name the other product's id, so the subject mapping is an interpretation, and the validators were all inconclusive.
